title: Apprentice (Technical-Engineer) Bengaluru, India Category: Interns/Temp Posted: 10/28/2026 Job ID: 19509
description: Job Description: Alternate Job Titles VLSI Characterization Apprentice Standard Cell Library Development Apprentice CMOS Circuit Simulation Apprentice Digital Library Characterization Trainee Semiconductor Characterization Trainee We Are Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. You Are You are someone who wants to learn how semiconductor design works, not from slides or theory, but by running real simulations on real circuits that will ship in real products. You spent time in the college understanding CMOS fundamentals and digital logic, and now you want to see how that knowledge translates into production-quality standard cell libraries. You are looking for a structured learning experience where you can work alongside engineers who have been doing characterization and library development for years. You want to build skills that matter, transistor-level debugging, EDA tool fluency, automation scripting, and the discipline to document your work so others can build on it. What You'll Be Doing Run transistor-level simulations on digital standard cells using industry-standard circuit simulators to extract timing, power, and leakage data across PVT corners Analyze CMOS circuit behavior at the transistor level, reviewing schematics, debugging simulation failures, and identifying issues in logic implementation or device models Support characterization and validation of standard cell libraries by running automated flows, reviewing results, and flagging anomalies or quality issues Document simulation results, technical findings, and circuit-level observations in clear, structured reports that senior engineers can act on Collaborate with library development engineers to improve characterization methodologies, refine automation scripts, and close gaps in coverage or accuracy Learn and apply concepts from Liberty (.lib) format, Static Timing Analysis, and low-power design as you work through real library development cycles Participate in technical reviews and team discussions to understand how characterization fits into the broader semiconductor design and IP development process The Impact You Will Have You will contribute to production-quality standard cell libraries that power chip designs across automotive, mobile, AI, and data center applications Your simulations and analysis will help catch timing, power, or functional issues before they reach customers, protecting design schedules and silicon success The characterization data you generate will support SoC designers as they meet performance, power, and area targets Your debugging work will surface circuit-level insights that improve library quality and inform next-generation design decisions You will help build and refine automation flows that make characterization faster, more accurate, and more scalable across technology nodes The documentation and analysis you create will enable senior engineers to make data-driven decisions about library tradeoffs and optimization strategies You will develop a strong foundation in semiconductor characterization and EDA tools that prepares you for the next stage of your engineering career What You'll Need B.E. or B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, VLSI, Microelectronics, or a related field 0 to 2 years of experience, fresh graduates are eligible and encouraged to apply Strong understanding of CMOS fundamentals including MOSFET operation, inverter characteristics, static and dynamic logic, noise margins, delay, power dissipation, and leakage mechanisms Solid knowledge of digital logic design including combinational and sequential circuits, Boolean algebra, flip-flops, latches, and timing concepts like setup, hold, recovery, and removal Familiarity with at least one circuit simulator such as PrimeSim, FineSim, and the ability to read and debug transistor-level schematics Comfort working in Linux or Unix environments, basic scripting knowledge in Python, Perl, Tcl, or Shell is a plus Exposure to standard cell libraries, Liberty format, or Static Timing Analysis concepts is a plus Who You Are You can look at a simulation waveform and spot when something is off, whether it is a timing violation, a leakage spike, or a logic glitch, and you are willing to dig in until you understand why You are comfortable working through ambiguity, if a simulation fails or results look strange, you check the netlist, review the setup, and try different scenarios before asking for help You take ownership of your work, when you run a characterization sweep or debug a circuit, you make sure the results are correct and the documentation is clear enough for someone else to pick up where you left off You communicate technical details clearly, whether you are writing up a simulation summary, flagging an issue in a review, or explaining a circuit behaviour to a peer or mentor You are genuinely curious about how things work at the transistor level and eager to learn advanced EDA tools, characterization flows, and semiconductor technologies from experienced engineers Key Program Facts: • Program Length: 12 months Apprenticeship Program • Location: Bengaluru, India • Working Model: 4-5 days in office • Full-Time/Part-Time: Full-time • Start Date: November/December 2026 Rewards and Benefits We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: FY27 Intern- Integration of a RISC-V CPU into a Cache-Coherent Emulation Platform - Sophia, 6 months
description: Company: Qualcomm France S.A.R.L. Job Area: Interns Group, Interns Group > Interim Intern General Summary: You will join the emulation team developing a CPU-based platform built around a memory interconnect. This platform is used to verify interoperability between key system IPs, including CPUs, the network-on-chip (NoC), and DDR controllers. It also supports their characterization and performance validation. The complete system will be mapped onto hardware emulators such as Palladium or Veloce. Internship Description The internship will take place at Qualcomm France’s R&D NoC technology center in Sophia Antipolis, within an office of approximately 50 engineers. The primary objective is to integrate Qualcomm latest RISC-V CPU into the emulation team existing RTL platform and connect it to a cache-coherent interconnect. The intern will reuse or develop boot code in C or assembly for execution on the CPU and integrate the RISC-V toolchain into the existing software build flow. The resulting RTL platform will first be compiled and validated using an RTL simulator, such as VCS or ModelSim, to debug the CPU integration and boot code. Finally, the platform will be compiled for Palladium or Veloce hardware emulators, enabling the development and execution of additional test cases on the RISC-V CPU. Progress of Internship Initial Training Understand the emulation team’s scope, constraints, and requirements, including testbench implementation, system validation, test case execution, and hardware emulation. Gain a good understanding of Qualcomm interconnects and how they interact with other system IPs. RISC-V architecture study Core Activities Collaborate with the CPU team to import and compile the RISC-V CPU RTL. Integrate the RISC-V CPU and interconnect into the emulation testbench used for the current mobile project. Develop or reuse boot code for the RISC-V CPU. Integrate the RISC-V toolchain into the existing software build flow. Run RTL simulations to validate and debug the CPU integration and C boot code. Compile the platform for a Palladium or Veloce hardware emulator, then validate and debug the CPU integration and boot-code execution. Bonus Port the emulation team’s complete suite of Arm-based C test cases to the RISC-V platform and run them in hardware emulation. Skills/Requirements Internship duration is 6 months Master’s degree in Microelectronics, Computer Science, or related field Experience with Verilog (preferably), or VHDL Ability to quickly react and adapt to changes Excellent communication skills, oral and written, French and English You will be part of one the advanced R&D center in Qualcomm, with the most competitive salary in the industry. Keywords: RISC-V, CPU integration, SoC, RTL, Verilog, hardware emulation, cache coherency, Network-on-Chip (NoC), C/assembly, boot code, Palladium, Veloce. *References to a particular number of years experience are for indicative purposes only. title: Mechatronic Apprentice I, Amazon Fulfillment RME, AUS2 RME
description: This permanent, full-time position is located in Jeffersonville, IN. Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey! About the Role: As a Mechatronics & Robotics Apprentice (MRA), you will learn to combine electronic, mechanical, computer and automation engineering skills at the workplace. During on-the-job learning (OJL) you will work with complex high-performance manufacturing systems and will learn to analyze, troubleshoot, and repair systems to maintain process efficiency. The focus of your role will be to learn the skills and abilities to ensure safety regulations and policies are adhered to, assist in the installation, maintenance, and repair of the automated packaging and distribution equipment, ensure preventative maintenance is conducted on time to a high standard, and provide high levels of equipment availability through continuous improvement. You will be paired with journey workers to carry out their work at various facilities, including high automation and robotics facilities in connection with service operations. You will be expected to complete work based on technical documents and instructions and carry out your work in compliance with the relevant provisions and safety regulations. You should be an effective communicator, work well in a team, and be self-motivated. You must have the ability to work collaboratively and coordinate your activities with upstream and downstream operations partners. In addition to developing your skills, you will be mentored by senior technicians to grow in your role. Key job responsibilities Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to: • You will perform preventative/predictive maintenance of conveyance equipment using the appropriate job plans, procedures, and manuals. • You will conduct maintenance and basic troubleshooting of robotics and robotic work cells. • You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all material handling equipment components. • You will maintain and troubleshoot motors, photo eyes, relays, proximity sensors, solenoids, motor starters, tachs, etc. • You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head Program Requirements: • Flexible to relocate after completion of the program • Able to enroll in and attend a 9-week training at one of four designated training providers (Location to be determined post-interview) • Meet the minimum qualifying score on a Mechanical Aptitude Test Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment. - High school diploma - 1+ years of PC software experience including Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook experience - vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 1+ years of Amazon RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) experience - Experience troubleshooting and repairing operational items - Knowledge of mathematics - Experience experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements - Work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays - 4+ years of military experience - Experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures - Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing material handling equipment (MHE) - Experience implementing safety standards - Experience reading blueprints and electrical schematics Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The starting pay for this position is listed below, including the base pay rate plus the highest available shift differential which applies depending on the shift you select. As a total compensation company, additional earnings may include shift differentials and overtime pay. Final pay will be based on factors including shift selection and location. Starting Day 1 of employment, Amazon offers EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, 401(k) matching. Learn more about our benefits at https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits . title: Software Engineer Intern - Software Engineer - Infotainment Platforms Validation
Internship - Software Engineering
description: Company Description WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy. As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in. We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide. This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today. We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level. Join us and let’s shape the future of data. Job Description We are looking for a Data Engineering Intern  to support our engineering operations team. This role covers applied work across schema design, data ingestion, API interfaces, template generation logic, and reporting dashboards — with exposure to multiple data types including relational, time-series, and vector/knowledge data. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Assist in database schema design and documentation for an automation system supporting engineering test operations. Develop and maintain ETL pipelines for data ingestion and transformation workflows. Build basic API interfaces for data access and integration with engineering platforms and systems Implement template parameter mapping and generation logic using templating frameworks. Support reporting and dashboarding development for engineering and operational metrics. Perform data quality checks and validation across structured and unstructured data sources. Maintain clear documentation for pipelines, schemas, and workflows. Participate in code reviews and maintain clean, well-documented code. This position is part of our Early Career program at WD. Our Early Career program is designed to support individuals beginning their professional career by providing the foundational training through a structured onboarding, mentorship, and development curriculum. Qualifications REQUIRED Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. Expected internship onboarding/start date: Early 2027. SKILLS Solid foundation in SQL and relational database concepts. Experience with Python for data handling and transformation (pandas / polars a plus). Familiarity with REST API concepts — consuming endpoints and mapping data.
